vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-MA U.S. Senate]: Edward Sen. Markey (D) has accumulated $23,151,961 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by Ripple Labs Inc ($1,000,000) and $1,081,500 from top-5 patrons)—out-raising general opponent John Deaton ($1,674,460) by 13.83x—exhibiting the "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm" profile. Markey's campaign apparatus absorbs $23,151,961 (anchored this cycle by Ripple Labs Inc ($1,000,000) and $1,081,500 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers.
